g.title: wiring
g.text: Sahhanito · ambulance monitor demo kit (ESP32-S3) · wiring
Demo only, not a medical device. Red = power, black = GND, blue = I²C (shared bus), green = UART, orange = analog / interrupts, purple = Bluetooth LE
